paragraphs: We are a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of novel, first-in-class or best-in-class therapies for metabolic and endocrine disorders.

In January 2022, we announced the initiation of a Phase 1 single ascending dose, or SAD, and multiple ascending dose, or MAD, clinical trial of VK2735, a novel dual agonist of the glucagon-like peptide 1, or GLP-1, and glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide, or GIP, receptors. VK2735 is being developed in both oral and subcutaneous formulations for the potential treatment of various metabolic disorders such as obesity.

In March 2023, we announced the completion of the Phase 1 trial. The study was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, SAD and MAD study in healthy adults. The primary objectives of the study included evaluation of the safety and tolerability of single and multiple doses of VK2735 delivered subcutaneously and the identification of VK2735 doses suitable for further clinical development. Study investigators also evaluated the pharmacokinetics of single and multiple doses of VK2735. Based upon the results from this Phase 1 study, in September 2023, we initiated the VENTURE study, a Phase 2 clinical trial of VK2735 in patients with obesity.

The Phase 2 VENTURE study was a randomized, double-blind placebo-controlled study to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and weight loss efficacy of VK2735, administered subcutaneously, once weekly. The 13-week study enrolled adults who were obese (BMI >= 30 kg/m2) or adults who were overweight (BMI >= 27kg/m2) with at least one weight-related co-morbidity condition. The primary endpoint of the study was the percent change in body weight from baseline to week 13, with secondary and exploratory endpoints evaluating a range of additional safety and efficacy measures. In October 2023, we announced completion of patient enrollment in the Phase 2 VENTURE study and on February 27, 2024, we announced that patients receiving weekly doses of VK2735 demonstrated statistically significant reductions in mean body weight after 13 weeks, ranging up to 14.7% from baseline. Patients receiving VK2735 also demonstrated statistically significant reductions in mean body weight relative to placebo, ranging up to 13.1%.

In June 2025, we announced the initiation of two Phase 3 clinical studies to evaluate the subcutaneous formulation of VK2735, VANQUISH-1 and VANQUISH-2. In November 2025, we announced completion of enrollment in the VANQUISH-1 study.

In March 2023, we announced the initiation of a Phase 1 clinical study to evaluate a novel oral formulation of VK2735. The study, which was an extension of our completed Phase 1 evaluation of subcutaneously administered VK2735, evaluated daily oral doses for 28 days. In March 2024, we announced that the 28-day MAD study results highlighted positive signs of clinical activity following treatment with oral VK2735. Cohorts receiving VK2735 demonstrated dose-dependent reductions in mean body weight from baseline, ranging up to approximately 5.3%.

In January 2025, we announced the initiation of a Phase 2 clinical trial of the oral tablet formulation of VK2735, and in August 2025, we announced positive top-line results from the trial. The Phase 2 VENTURE-Oral Dosing trial successfully achieved its primary and secondary endpoints, with patients receiving oral VK2735 demonstrating statistically significant reductions in body weight compared with placebo. Additionally, the trial showed oral VK2735 treatment to be safe and well-tolerated through 13 weeks of daily dosing with the majority of treatment emergent adverse events being categorized as mild or moderate. We expect to initiate Phase 3 Oral dosing studies in the third quarter of 2026.

In October 2025, we announced the initiation of an exploratory Phase 1 maintenance dosing study of VK2735. This study is intended to explore the feasibility of various VK2735 maintenance dosing regimens utilizing either the oral tablet or the subcutaneous formulation to sustain the initial weight loss achieved following subcutaneous dosing. In January 2026, we announced completion of enrollment in this study.

In March 2025, we entered into broad, multi-year manufacturing agreements, or the Manufacturing Agreements, with Corden Pharma Colorado, Inc. and its affiliates, or CordenPharma, covering both the active pharmaceutical ingredient, or API, and final finished product supply for VK2735.

Under the terms of the Manufacturing Agreements, we have secured dedicated capacity for the annual manufacture and supply of multiple metric tons of VK2735 API. In addition, CordenPharma will provide fill/finish capacity for both the injectable and oral formulations of VK2735. This includes dedicated manufacturing lines and an annual commitment to supply 100 million autoinjectors and an additional 100 million vial and syringe products for the subcutaneous formulation, as well as an annual capacity of over one billion oral VK2735 tablets. These API and final finished product capacities are further expandable at Viking's option. In exchange for dedicated API and fill/finish capacity, we will make prepayments to CordenPharma, to be paid over the period from 2026 to 2028. These prepayments will be fully credited against future orders.

In 2024, we announced a new, internally developed Dual Amylin and Calcitonin Receptor Agonist, or DACRA, program for the treatment of obesity and highlighted the effects of treatment on body weight, food intake and metabolic profile in both healthy rats and in diet-induced obese mice. The results demonstrated that our DACRAs reduced food intake in lean rats in the period from 0 – 72 hours following a single subcutaneous dose. We plan to file an Investigational New Drug, or IND, application for this program in the first quarter of 2026.

We are also developing VK2809, which is an orally available, tissue and receptor-subtype selective agonist of the thyroid hormone receptor beta, or TRß. In November 2019, we initiated the VOYAGE study, a Phase 2b clinical trial of VK2809 in patients with biopsy-confirmed non-alcoholic steatohepatitis, or NASH/MASH.

The VOYAGE study was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter trial designed to assess the efficacy, safety and tolerability of VK2809 in patients with biopsy-confirmed NASH/MASH and fibrosis ranging from stages F1 to F3. The primary endpoint of the study evaluated the relative change in liver fat content, as assessed by magnetic resonance imaging, proton density fat fraction, or MRI-PDFF, from baseline to week 12 in subjects treated with VK2809 as compared to placebo. Secondary objectives included evaluation of histologic changes assessed by hepatic biopsy after 52 weeks of dosing.

In January 2023, we announced completion of patient enrollment in the VOYAGE study and in May 2023 we reported that the VOYAGE study successfully achieved its primary endpoint, with patients receiving VK2809 experiencing statistically significant reductions in liver fat content from baseline to Week 12 as compared to placebo.

headings: Risk Factor Summary
Risks Relating to Our Business
We are a clinical-stage company, have a limited operating history and are expected to incur significant operating losses during the next stages of our corporate development.
We are dependent on the success of one or more of our current drug candidates and we cannot be certain that any of them will receive regulatory approval or be commercialized.
If development of our drug candidates does not produce favorable results, we and our collaborators, if any, may be unable to commercialize these products.
We expect to continue to incur significant research and development expenses, which may make it difficult for us to attain profitability.
Our efforts to discover drug candidates beyond our current drug candidates may not succeed, and any drug candidates we recommend for clinical development may not actually begin clinical trials.
Delays in the commencement or completion of clinical trials could result in increased costs to us and delay our ability to establish strategic collaborations.
Results of earlier clinical trials may not be predictive of the results of later-stage clinical trials.
If we experience delays in the enrollment of patients in our clinical trials, our receipt of necessary regulatory approvals could be delayed or prevented.
Even if our drug candidates receive regulatory approval in the U.S., we may never receive approval or commercialize our products outside of the U.S.
Even if any of our drug candidates receive regulatory approval, our drug candidates may still face future development and regulatory difficulties.
The FDA, EMA and comparable foreign authorities actively enforce the laws and regulations prohibiting the promotion of off-label uses.
We, or any future collaborators, may not be able to obtain or maintain orphan drug designation or orphan drug exclusivity for our product candidates.
paragraphs: You should consider carefully the following information about the risks described below, together with the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and in our other public filings in evaluating our business. If any of the following risks actually occurs, our business, financial condition, results of operations and future growth prospects would likely be materially and adversely affected. In these circumstances, the market price of our common stock would likely decline.

Below is a summary of the principal factors that make an investment in our common stock speculative or risky. This summary does not address all of the risks that we face. Additional discussion of the risks summarized in this risk factor summary, and other risks that we face, can be found below under the heading "Risk Factors" and should be carefully considered, together with other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and our other filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission, or the SEC, before making an investment decision regarding our common stock.
• We are a clinical-stage company, have a limited operating history and are expected to incur significant operating losses during the next stages of our corporate development.

• We are substantially dependent on technologies we licensed from Ligand Pharmaceuticals Incorporated, or Ligand, and if we lose the license to such technologies or our master license agreement with Ligand, or the Master License Agreement, is terminated for any reason, our ability to develop existing and new drug candidates would be harmed, and our business, financial condition and results of operations would be materially and adversely affected.
• We are dependent on the success of one or more of our current drug candidates and we cannot be certain that any of them will receive regulatory approval or be commercialized.
• If development of our drug candidates does not produce favorable results, we and our collaborators, if any, may be unable to commercialize these products.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家臨牀階段生技藥品公司，專注於開發用以治療代謝及內分泌疾病之新型、首創或最佳治療方案之療法。

2022年1月，本公司宣佈啟動VK2735之第一期單劑遞增（Single Ascending Dose, SAD）及多劑遞增（Multiple Ascending Dose, MAD）臨牀試驗，VK2735為一種新型GLP-1（Glucagon-like Peptide 1）與GIP（Glucose-dependent Insulinotropic Polypeptide）雙效激動劑，用以治療肥胖等多種代謝疾病，開發形式包括口服與皮下注射。
2023年3月，本公司宣佈完成第一期試驗。該試驗為一隨機雙盲安慰劑對照試驗，於健康成人進行，評估單劑與多劑皮下注射VK2735之安全性與耐受性，並識別適合進一步臨牀開發之VK2735劑量。試驗研究者同時評估單劑與多劑VK2735之藥動學。根據第一期試驗結果，本公司於2023年9月啟動VENTURE試驗，為VK2735在肥胖患者之第二期臨牀試驗。

第二期VENTURE試驗為一隨機雙盲安慰劑對照試驗，評估皮下注射VK2735（每週一次）之安全性、耐受性、藥動學及減重療效。13週試驗納入肥胖（BMI >= 30 kg/m2）或過重（BMI >= 27 kg/m2）且至少有一項與體重相關共病之成人。試驗主要評估指標為基線至第13週體重變動百分比，次要及探索性評估指標則評估其他安全與療效指標。2023年10月，本公司宣佈完成第二期VENTURE試驗之受試者入組，2024年2月27日宣佈接受每週VK2735注射之受試者，在13週後體重平均顯著減少，最高達基線值14.7%。接受VK2735治療之受試者，其體重平均顯著減少，相較於安慰劑，最高達13.1%。
2025年6月，本公司宣佈啟動兩項第三期臨牀試驗，評估VK2735皮下注射形式，名為VANQUISH-1及VANQUISH-2。2025年11月，本公司宣佈完成VANQUISH-1試驗之受試者入組。
2023年3月，本公司宣佈啟動一項評估VK2735口服形式之第一期臨牀試驗。該試驗為本公司已完成皮下注射VK2735第一期評估之延續，評估每日口服劑量28日之效果。2024年3月，本公司宣佈28日多劑遞增試驗結果顯示口服VK2735治療後出現臨牀活動之正面跡象。接受VK2735治療之組別顯示劑量依賴性體重減少，最高達約5.3%。

2025年1月，本公司宣佈啟動口服片劑形式VK2735之第二期臨牀試驗，2025年8月宣佈該試驗之初步結果為正面。第二期VENTURE-Oral Dosing試驗成功達成主要及次要評估指標，接受口服VK2735治療之受試者，其體重平均顯著減少，相較於安慰劑。此外，試驗顯示口服VK2735治療在13週每日劑量下為安全且耐受性良好，大多數治療相關不良事件被歸類為輕度或中度。本公司預期於2026年第三季啟動口服劑量之第三期試驗。
2025年10月，本公司宣佈啟動一項探索性第一期維持劑量試驗，評估VK2735之不同維持劑量方案，利用口服片劑或皮下注射形式，以維持皮下注射後所達成之初始減重效果。2026年1月，本公司宣佈完成該試驗之受試者入組。
2025年3月，本公司與Corden Pharma Colorado, Inc.及其關係企業，或CordenPharma，簽訂了廣泛的多年製造協議，或製造協議，涵蓋VK2735的活性藥物成分，或API，以及最終成品供應。

根據製造協議的條款，本公司已取得專用的年度製造與供應能力，用以生產多公噸的VK2735 API。此外，CordenPharma將提供填充/灌裝能力，用以製造VK2735的注射劑與口服製劑。這包括專用的製造線，以及每年承諾供應100百萬自動注射器，以及額外的100百萬瓶與注射器產品用於皮下製劑，以及每年超過十億片的口服VK2735片劑。這些API與最終成品的生產能力，於Viking的選擇下，還可進一步擴充。為換取專用的API與填充/灌裝能力，本公司將向CordenPharma預付費用，預付費用將於2026年至2028年期間支付。這些預付款項將完全抵扣未來的訂單。

2024年，本公司宣佈了一項新開發的內部Dual Amylin and Calcitonin Receptor Agonist，或DACRA，計畫，用於治療肥胖，並強調治療對健康大鼠與飲食誘導肥胖小鼠的體重、食量與代謝型態的影響。結果顯示，我們的DACRAs在單次皮下注射後0至72小時內，使健康大鼠的食量顯著減少。我們計畫於2026年第一季提交 Investigational New Drug，或IND，申請。
本公司同時也在開發VK2809，這是一種口服可用、組織與受體亞型選擇性活化劑，針對甲狀腺激素受體β，或TRß。2019年11月，我們啟動了VOYAGE研究，這是一項針對經活檢確認的非酒精性脂肪肝炎，或NASH/MASH患者的第二期b臨牀試驗。

VOYAGE研究是一項隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照、多中心試驗，旨在評估VK2809在經活檢確認的NASH/MASH患者，且纖維化程度從F1至F3階段的患者中，於有效性、安全性與耐受性的表現。該研究的主要評估指標為評估從基線至第12週，接受VK2809治療的受試者與安慰劑組相比，肝脂肪含量的相對變化，以磁共振成像，質子密度脂肪分數，或MRI-PDFF評估。次要目標包括評估在52週給藥後的組織學變化，以肝臟活檢評估。
2023年1月，本公司宣佈VOYAGE研究完成受試者入組，2023年5月，我們報告VOYAGE研究成功達成主要評估指標，接受VK2809治療的受試者，與安慰劑組相比，其肝脂肪含量從基線至第12週顯著減少。

下列對我們財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析，包含若干前瞻性陳述，這些陳述涉及多種風險、不確定性與假設。實際發生的事件或結果可能與我們的預期有重大差異。可能導致實際結果與我們前瞻性陳述所表達或暗示的結果有重大差異的重要因素，包含但不限於本年度10-K表報表第一部分「第1A項 風險因素」所列述的內容。本年度10-K表報表中所有包含的前瞻性陳述，均根據我們在提交本年度10-K表報表時所掌握的資訊，除非法律有強制要求，否則我們不承擔更新公開資訊或修正任何前瞻性陳述的義務。
本公司為一家臨牀階段的生物科技公司，專注於開發用以治療代謝與內分泌疾病的創新、首創或最佳治療方案。
2022年1月，我們宣佈啟動VK2735的第1期單劑量遞增（SAD）與多劑量遞增（MAD）臨牀試驗，VK2735為一種新型GLP-1（胰高血糖素類肽1）與GIP（葡萄糖依賴性胰島素促進激素）受體雙效激動劑。VK2735正在開發口服與皮下注射兩種劑型，用以潛在治療各種代謝疾病，例如肥胖。
2023年3月，我們宣佈完成第1期試驗。該試驗為一項隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照的SAD與MAD試驗，參與者為健康成人。試驗的主要目標包括評估皮下注射單劑與多劑VK2735的安全性與耐受性，並識別適合進一步臨牀開發的VK2735劑量。試驗研究者同時評估單劑與多劑VK2735的藥動學。根據本第1期試驗的結果，我們於2023年9月啟動VENTURE試驗，為一項針對肥胖患者的第2期臨牀試驗。

第2期VENTURE試驗為一項隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照試驗，用以評估皮下注射、每週一次的VK2735在安全性、耐受性、藥動學與減重效果。該13週試驗納入肥胖成人（BMI >= 30 kg/m2）或過重成人（BMI >= 27 kg/m2）且至少有一項與體重相關的共病條件。試驗的主要評估指標為從基線至第13週的體重百分比變化，次要與探索性評估指標則評估一系列其他安全性與有效性措施。2023年10月，我們宣佈完成第2期VENTURE試驗的受試者招募；2024年2月27日，我們宣佈接受週ly劑量VK2735治療的受試者，在13週後顯示體重平均顯著下降，最高達基線值的14.7%。接受VK2735治療的受試者也顯示與安慰劑相比，體重平均顯著下降，最高達基線值的13.1%。
2025年6月，我們宣佈啟動兩項第3期臨牀試驗，用以評估VK2735皮下注射劑型，名為VANQUISH-1與VANQUISH-2。2025年11月，我們宣佈完成VANQUISH-1試驗的受試者招募。
2023年3月，我們宣佈啟動一項第1期臨牀試驗，用以評估VK2735的新型口服劑型。該試驗為我們已完成皮下注射VK2735第1期評估的延續，評估每日口服劑量28天的結果。2024年3月，我們宣佈28天MAD試驗結果顯示口服VK2735治療後出現正面的臨牀活動跡象。接受VK2735治療的組別顯示體重平均從基線值減少，且呈現劑量依賴性，最高達約5.3%。

2025年1月，本公司宣佈啟動VK2735口服錠劑形式的第二期臨牀試驗，並於2025年8月宣佈該試驗的初步結果為正面。第二期VENTURE-Oral Dosing試驗成功達成其主要及次要終點，接受口服VK2735治療的病患與安慰劑組相比，體重顯著下降。此外，該試驗顯示口服VK2735治療在13週每日給藥期間為安全且耐受性良好，大多數治療期間出現的不良事件被歸類為輕度或中度。本公司預期於2026年第三季啟動第三期口服給藥研究。
2025年10月，本公司宣佈啟動VK2735的探索性第一期維持劑量試驗。此試驗旨在探討不同VK2735維持劑量方案的可行性，使用口服錠劑或皮下注射形式以維持皮下注射後的初始減重效果。2026年1月，本公司宣佈完成此試驗的入組。
2024年，本公司宣佈開發出新的內部研發雙胺鈉與降鈣素受體激動劑，或稱DACRA，用於治療肥胖，並說明治療對健康大鼠及飲食誘導肥胖小鼠的體重、飲食攝取及代謝指標的影響。結果顯示，本公司DACRAs在單次皮下注射後0至72小時內，可減少健康大鼠的飲食攝取。本公司預計於2026年第一季提交 Investigational New Drug，或IND，申請。
2025年3月，本公司與Corden Pharma Colorado, Inc.及其附屬公司，或稱CordenPharma，簽訂廣泛的多年製造協議，或稱製造協議，涵蓋VK2735的活性藥物成分，或API，及最終成品供應。

根據製造協議的條款，本公司已取得專用的年度製造與供應能力，用於生產多公噸的VK2735 API。此外，CordenPharma將提供填充/灌裝能力，用於VK2735的注射劑及口服形式。這包括專用製造線及年度承諾供應100百萬個自動注射器，以及額外100百萬支與針筒產品用於皮下注射形式，以及年度生產能力超過十億片口服VK2735錠劑。這些API及最終成品的生產能力在Viking的選擇下可進一步擴張。為換取專用API及填充/灌裝能力，本公司將向CordenPharma支付預付款，於2026至2028年期間支付。這些預付款將完全抵扣未來訂單。

我們依賴目前藥物候選品之一或數個的成功，無法確定任何藥物候選品是否會獲得監管機構批准或進行商業化。
若藥物候選品的開發結果不理想，本公司及其合作夥伴（如有）可能無法商業化這些產品。
本公司預期將持續產生顯著的研究與開發費用，這可能使本公司難以達成獲利。
本公司努力發現超出目前藥物候選品的藥物候選品可能不會成功，且本公司推薦進行臨牀開發的藥物候選品可能實際上不會開始臨牀試驗。
臨牀試驗的開始或完成出現延誤，可能導致本公司成本增加，並延誤本公司建立戰略合作關係的能力。
較早期臨牀試驗的結果可能無法預測後期臨牀試驗的結果。
若我們在臨牀試驗中遭遇患者入組延遲，我們取得必要監管核准的時間可能延遲或無法取得。
即使我們的藥物候選品在美國獲得監管核准，我們可能永遠無法獲得核准或在美國以外的地區商業化我們的產品。
即使任何我們的藥物候選品獲得監管核准，我們的藥物候選品仍可能面臨未來的開發與監管困難。
FDA、EMA 及其他相當的外國監管機構積極執行禁止推廣未經核准用途的法律與規範。
我們，或任何未來的合作夥伴，可能無法取得或維持我們產品候選品的罕見疾病藥物指定或罕見疾病藥物獨佔權。
